title: Evaluation of the safety and efficacy of Bevacizumab in patients with persistent respiratory disorders after COVID-19 infection
official: BASECOVID - Bevacizumab in post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 : Efficacy and Safety (Pilot Study)
summary: Main objective: To assess efficacy of bevacizumab injection in long COVID patients with impaired DLCO (<75% of predicted value) within 3 months after the first bevacizumab injection. The positive criteria will be a 10% increase in DLCO at three months after the introduction of bevacizumab.
conditions: Adult patients with persistent dyspnea more than 3 months after acute COVID-19 infection.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1-	Patients over 18 years ≤70 years
2. 2-	Social security affiliation
3. 3-	Good understanding of the French language
4. 4-	Written informed consent
5. 5-	Documented COVID-19 infection (PCR or CT scan) more than 3 months before inclusion
6. 6-	Long COVID suspicion with dyspnea (mMRC≥2 at inclusion)
7. 7-	DLCO<75% of predicted value less than 3 months old on the day of screening or to be obtained before Day 1 if older than 3 months.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1-	Acute COVID-19 infection
2. 22-	Pregnant or breastfeeding women
3. 23-	Vulnerable populations (patient under guardianship, curatorship, deprived of liberty)
4. 2-	Lung scintigraphy and thoracic CT angiography evaluation to rule out pulmonary embolism
5. 24-	Patient on AME (state medical aid)
6. 3-	Women of childbearing potential
7. 4-	Myocardial infarction or stroke
8. 5-	Uncontrolled hypertension (>140/90 at inclusion in the study)
9. 6-	Proteinuria/creatinuria ratio > 50mg/mmol at baseline
10. 8-	History of malignant hypertension
11. 10 -	Previous osteonecrosis
12. 14-	Active cancer
13. 11-	History of Aneurysms and artery dissections
14. 7-	DFG<30 ml/min
15. 9-	Diagnosis of other pulmonary diseases known to impair DLCO (such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [COPD], idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, interstitial lung diseases unrelated to COVID-19, or other significant chronic pulmonary conditions)
16. 12-	History of hemoptysis of any grade
17. 13-	History of congestive heart failure (NYHA class II-IV)
18. 15-	Known hypersensitivity to bevacizumab or any ingredient in its formulation, including non-medicinal ingredients, or a component of the container
19. 16-	Hypersensitivity to Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cell products or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies.
20. 17-	History of Radiotherapy
21. 18-	History of bisphosphonates treatment
22. 19-	Surgery in 28 days before inclusion
23. 20-	Participation in another interventional study or being in the exclusion period at the end of a previous study
24. 21-	Patient unable or unwilling to comply with the follow-up schedule (at the investigator's discretion)
